title: After the Japanese Derby: Victory Hashtag!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser owns all 2,400 meters!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I… did it…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I DID IIIIIT!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I won, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser?! No way! I can't believe it!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: I never would've guessed Mihono Bourbon would lose in a million years! And Rice Shower ran so well too…

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Look over there! It's Mihono Bourbon and Rice Shower!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …Sigh. I couldn't do it… I still haven't changed…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: That's not true.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: You've gotten much better since the Satsuki Sho. I've been watching you and I've certainly felt your improvement.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I'm certain you're my biggest threat at the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Bourbon… I… I…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'll definitely get first place next time! I'm going to make everyone smile!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Chatter, chatter!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: I'm pretty sure I read something about that the other day in an article online!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: I saw that too! It said Mihono Bourbon was watching out for her. I thought they were just exaggerating, but…

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Holy cow! I guess it was true! Now I'm really looking forward to the Kikuka Sho all of a sudden!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The crowd claps just as much for the two of them as they do for Matikanetannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Look! Mihono Bourbon and Rice Shower are trending!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: But Machitan's the one who won… Isn't that kind of, like, disrespectful?

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: …I sure hope this doesn't blow up into some drama.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Come to think about it, it did seem like there were a lot of people clapping for Bourbon and Rice.
choice_data_list: Don't let it get to you.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, no! That's not it! I was just making an observation!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: They're both top contenders themselves. Of course they're gonna get a lot of attention.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Besides, winning is what matters and I'm A-OK on that front!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, right! Will you take a picture with me? I wanna post it on social media!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I've always wanted to make a post with "#DerbyWinner"!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: "The Japanese Derby is mine! I was so excited for the race that this feels like a dream! I'm gonna bring it in the Kikuka Sho too! (elephant emoji)"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: …What do you think, Trainer? Is that okay? You think it needs more memes?
choice_data_list: I think it's good the way it is.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Great! Aaand… posted!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Phew, that takes care of that! There's so much to do after you achieve your dre—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Aghhh!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I forgot to add the hashtag!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At any rate, the Japanese Derby draws to a close after a great showing from Matikanetannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I was just reading some comments on the post I made after the Japanese Derby…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: "Exactly! The most important thing in a competition is winning. I could learn something from her!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: "If Tannhauser doesn't care about the spotlight, who are we to argue?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: They're all like this, but… what are they talking about? What do they mean I don't care about the spotlight?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the Japanese Derby, there was more attention on some of the other runners, despite Tannhauser winning. This got some of the fans arguing with each other.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser herself paid it no mind and just took genuine pleasure in her win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That honest innocence ended up earning her a lot of praise online.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Sounds like there's just one thing to do… Time to look up myself online!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems like she really doesn't have any idea about the drama.
choice_data_list: (I guess she's just not interested. Or maybe…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She never thought she would find herself at the center of online drama.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In any case… next up is the Kikuka Sho. As always, we're aiming to win.
